author: Inside Edition
description: Convicted school shooter Colt Gray was sentenced to life without the possibility of parole earlier this week. But it was his father, Colin Gray, who bought the gun the teen used to kill two students and two teachers at a Georgia school. Today it was Colin's turn to learn his fate at a sentencing hearing. Another case in which prosecutors are trying to hold a parent responsible for a mass shooting is set to go to trial in Wisconsin next year. Inside Edition's Justin Finch has more.
title: Colin Gray, Father Of Georgia School Shooter Colt Gray, Is Sentenced

author: Inside Edition
description: We watched in awe as a teen-aged lifeguard fought monster waves to rescue a drowning 10-year-old in Southern California. Now it's happened again, with brave young heroes putting their lives on the line. This summer has been one of the busiest on record for California lifeguards, who've made thousands of rescues. Weather patterns hundreds of miles off the coast are making for bigger than usual waves on beaches. Inside Edition's Jim Moret has more.
title: Young Lifeguard Heroes Make Rescues On California Coast

author: Inside Edition
description: An adventurous little boy decided to go to his grandmother's house all by himself. The enterprising three-year-old hiked half a mile solo through his family's Idaho neighborhood, and his temporary disappearance gave his family a fright. Fortunately, he arrived safe and sound. His odyssey was caught on home surveillance cameras, and now his family is looking at how to keep him safe in the future. Inside Edition's Justin Finch has more.
title: 3-Year-Old's Half-Mile Escape To Grandma's House Caught On Surveillance Camera

author: Inside Edition
description: It's always a touching wedding reception moment when the groom dances with his mom. But one Texas groom had a mother-son dance with a partner who wasn't his mother. She was a stranger, but one with whom he shared a very unusual bond. The woman was breathing with his late mother's lungs. They hope their turn on the dance floor will encourage more people to register as organ donors. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has the details.
title: Groom Dances With Woman Who Received His Mother's Lungs

author: Inside Edition
description: They sure make them tough in Montana. David Cifaldi was hiking on the state's highest peak when he slipped, fell, and accidentally impaled himself on a four-foot-long hiking pole. That freak accident was just the beginning of a saga of true grit and survival, as Inside Edition's Steven Fabian reports. David is facing medical bills and more surgery, and has set up a GoFundMe. If you want more information you can go to: https://www.gofundme.com/f/impaled-at-11800-feet-er-nurse-selfrescued-10-miles-out
title: Injured Nurse Hikes 10 Miles After Being Impaled By Walking Pole

author: Inside Edition
description: The emotionally charged trial of a Massachusetts mom accused of strangling her three young children continued today with more heartbreaking testimony. Lindsay Clancy faces three counts of first-degree murder, as well as three counts of strangulation. The defense claims Clancy is not guilty of murder and was suffering from postpartum depression and postpartum psychosis. Meanwhile, we're learning about a new life her grieving ex-husband is creating. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has more.
title: Heartbreaking Testimony Continues In Lindsay Clancy's Murder Trial

description: Ever read Playboy for the articles? What about surfing Onlyfans for animal content? If taking a look at Marmats ever crossed your mind, there is a page dedicated to just to them. Daniel Blumstein, a professor in the Department of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology at UCLA started Onlymarms as a way to raise funds and draw attention to research on the species. "The meta message is really one about the sad state of scientific funding, and this is the scientific funding that made us as a country rich, and the producer of knowledge for the world, and the educator of the world, and that's what's at threat," he tells Inside Edition Digital.
title: 'OnlyMarms' is the G-Rated OnlyFans Page Marmot Researchers Use to Fundraise
